related.title: Sleipner 油氣與碳封存
related.why: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.whyEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移物料守恆、代表取樣及環境證據；物相、搬運路徑與回收方法需重設。
related.transferEn: Material balance, representative sampling and environmental evidence transfer while phases, handling paths and recovery methods must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援；Sleipner 油氣與碳封存改以分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on gravity bases, shore power and compression support; Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage centers on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Troll油氣與壓力與油氣與CO2物料，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Sleipner 油氣與碳封存，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以平臺系統與恢復為起點，設計一項能區分「重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援」與「分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare troll oil/gas pressure with hydrocarbon/co2 balance and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from platform systems/recovery and propose an observation distinguishing gravity bases, shore power and compression support from separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries, including uncertainty.

related.title: Johan Sverdrup 海上油田

practiceEn: Compare troll oil/gas pressure with reservoir material/pressure and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Johan Sverdrup offshore oilfield, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

history.title: Troll 海上油氣平臺
history.text: Troll 海上油氣平臺的公開資料展示重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Troll offshore oil/gas platforms illustrate gravity bases, shore power and compression support. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將重力基礎、岸電與壓縮支援改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns gravity bases, shore power and compression support into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
